# Status quo (do nothing)

<!-- policy: descriptive -->

## Snapshot

Not a vendor. Tracked because deals are lost to it more often than to any named
competitor: manual review, spreadsheets, existing platform settings, and a
decision to defer. Included so the framework can hold the alternative that has
no marketing site.

## Capabilities observed

- Zero licence cost, no procurement cycle, no security review
  (first-hand, 2026-09-02).

## Gaps observed against stated buyer criteria

- No coverage measurement. Buyers who deferred could not answer how much data
  was exposed (first-hand, 2026-09-02).

## Open questions

- Which trigger events move a deferred buyer into an active evaluation.
